text_block_list.text:
The two selected Legacy Umamusume
and
your Trainee Umamusume have an
affinity
level determined by their
relationship.
text_block_list.name: Тазуна Хаякава

text_block_list.text:
It's said that if they share a good
affinity,
it becomes a little more likely
for
something nice to happen.
text_block_list.name: Тазуна Хаякава

text_block_list.text:
This might be good to remember when

you're making arrangements in the

future. ♪
text_block_list.name: Тазуна Хаякава
